claims.text: Complement-mediated HUS: eculizumab, ravulizumab or pegcetacoplan can often reverse kidney failure.
claims.quote: In patients with HUS caused by complement dysregulation (including most children), complement inhibition with eculizumab, ravulizumab, or pegcetacoplan can often reverse the kidney failure

claims.text: Typical diarrhea-associated HUS in children: eculizumab or ravulizumab = commonly given if dialysis = needed.
claims.quote: Typical diarrhea-associated HUS in children caused by enterohemorrhagic infection usually spontaneously remits and is treated with supportive care; antibiotics are not used. Over half of patients require renal dialysis, in which case eculizumab or ravulizumab is commonly given

claims.text: Give the meningococcal vax (higher meningococcal meningitis risk).
claims.quote: Patients who take eculizumab, ravulizumab, or pegcetacoplan are at higher risk for meningococcal meningitis, so they should receive the meningococcal vaccine

claims.text: STEC producing Shiga toxin 2 (or toxin unknown): avoid abx;
claims.quote: Antimicrobial therapy for people with infections attributed to STEC O157 and other STEC that produce Shiga toxin 2 (or if the toxin genotype is unknown) should be avoided

claims.text: abx and antidiarrheals in STEC diarrhea may ↑HUS risk.
claims.quote: Antimicrobial agents and antidiarrheal medications administered to people with diarrhea caused by STEC infections may increase the risk of HUS
